description: This Java class, ProductMixDataValidator, performs validation of JSON data related to product mix configurations in the Fineract system. It handles validation for creating and updating product mix data, ensuring correct JSON structure, supported parameters, and valid product IDs.

classes.name: ProductMixDataValidator
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component that validates JSON data for product mix configurations, focusing on restricted products during creation and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for creating a product mix, checking for unsupported parameters, presence and correctness of restricted products array, and individual product ID validity.

methods.name: validateRestrictedProducts
methods.description: Iterates over each restricted product ID, validating that it is not blank and greater than zero.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any accumulated validation errors.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for updating a product mix, similar to validateForCreate but without checking for empty restricted products array.
